name: SlidingDoorPanels
job: Cover a full-bleed photo with seamless smoked-glass slabs that slide apart to reveal the next image, one slab at a time in a rhythm
visitor_action: click the arrows or let it auto-advance; swipe on touch; arrow keys browse when focused
mobile: 3 wide slabs, 4:5 crop, caption above a controls row, swipe advances
motion: slabs glide apart staggered with a long ease and park fully off the photo; closed beat shows the photo ghosting through smoked glass; caption rises in once open (reduced-motion: slabs stay parked, photos crossfade)
art_direction: Dark cinematic architecture: full-bleed photo with no frame or card, seamless smoked-glass slabs (no grid lines), one big light Jost headline caption in pale ink #f1efe9 on near-black #07080a, Space Grotesk counter and bare arrow controls overlaid bottom-right
